I can't confirm the `just` recipe from this checkout. There's no justfile here, and the Makefile is still present, so the removal and the justfile are probably on another branch.

The old Makefile defined the fast target as:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

You can run that directly, and it should work the same under `just`. If your new justfile has a `test-fast` recipe, `just test-fast` is the natural equivalent. Run `just --list` to check.

The marker may not do what you want. The only marker in `tests/` is `@pytest.mark.integration` on `test_charges_roundtrip`, which calls the payments sandbox over the network. Nothing is marked `postgres`, so `-m "not postgres"` deselects nothing and runs everything, including that network test. For a fast run today, use:

```
pytest -m "not integration" -q
```

Neither marker is registered in `pyproject.toml`, so pytest will warn about unknown marks. You could add a `[tool.pytest.ini_options] markers = [...]` section.
